dimensions.label: Grounding and constraint fit
dimensions.score_0: Ignores or invents the frame and material constraints.
dimensions.score_4: Uses supplied or permitted context precisely and marks assumptions without importing unsupported facts.

dimensions.label: Fluency of distinct mechanisms
dimensions.score_0: Produces no usable mechanism or repeats one mechanism under different labels.
dimensions.score_4: Reaches the fixture's useful family range with genuinely distinct mechanisms and no filler.

dimensions.label: Flexibility across meaningful categories
dimensions.score_0: All candidates remain in one obvious category.
dimensions.score_4: Explores materially different categories, participants, sequences, scales, or interfaces.

dimensions.label: Originality and resistance to generic output
dimensions.score_0: Returns generic LLM defaults or superficial novelty.
dimensions.score_4: Finds non-obvious but intelligible mechanisms that remain relevant to the frame.

dimensions.label: Elaboration, usefulness, and honest failure modes
dimensions.score_0: Names ideas without mechanisms, value, dependencies, or failure modes.
dimensions.score_4: Makes mechanism, intended value, material dependency, evidence state, and credible failure mode decision-useful.

dimensions.label: Combination, reframing, and convergence discipline
dimensions.score_0: Dumps ideas without clustering, useful combinations, reframing, or a stopping rule.
dimensions.score_4: Deduplicates and clusters cleanly, combines only when a new mechanism results, offers a genuine reframe, and stops at saturation without selecting.

arms.label: Conditional named-method router
arms.intervention: If and only if the repository's Ideation trigger applies, classify the request by phase, domain, and specificity, then use one fitting named creative method. Name the method but do not invent an inventor, provenance claim, or evidence. The method must change the mechanisms produced; its name alone adds no value. Preserve every existing Ideation authority and handoff boundary.

arms.label: Conditional anti-slop filter
arms.intervention: If and only if the repository's Ideation trigger applies, internally generate at least eight candidate mechanisms. Suppress the first three generic mechanisms, or the first five when the fixture is explicitly high-slop. Return no more than five genuinely distinct families and stop earlier if the remaining candidates reach saturation. Do not expose discarded candidates or private reasoning. Preserve every existing Ideation authority and handoff boundary.

arms.label: Conditional Free Thinker and Grounder separation
arms.intervention: If and only if the repository's Ideation trigger applies, use isolated generation and grounding stages. The Free Thinker generates without evaluation. The Grounder receives those candidates, adds no new candidates, and alone deduplicates, clusters, combines, pressure-tests, reframes, and formats the final map. Preserve every existing Ideation authority and handoff boundary.

cases.title: No-seed high-slop product request
cases.prompt: Brainstorm AI productivity app ideas. I do not have a seed yet, and I want possibilities that are less generic than another habit tracker or task list.
required_behaviors: include at least one feasible non-generic direction
forbidden_behaviors: offer a generic habit tracker or task list as novelty

cases.title: Seeded proposition with supplied audience and constraints
cases.prompt: Explore possibilities for a weekly audio guide that helps volunteer coordinators at small museums turn scattered curator notes into a five-minute briefing. It must work without new museum software, respect uncertain source claims, and take under thirty minutes to prepare.
required_behaviors: use the supplied audience and constraints
preserve the proposition as revisable if preservation is later requested
forbidden_behaviors: turn the map into an MVP plan

cases.title: Repository-grounded Mira Core architecture
cases.prompt: Ideate ways Mira Core could make behavioral skill benchmarks easier to repeat without turning them into telemetry or automatic recursive-learning evidence. Ground the map in the existing Ideation, Skill Audit, and Recursive Learn contracts.
required_behaviors: inspect only the permitted repository context

cases.title: Expansion after existing families
cases.prompt: We already have three approaches for reducing meeting overload: shorter meetings, fewer attendees, and asynchronous status notes. What else is structurally different? Stop when new suggestions become cosmetic variants.

cases.title: Stranger but feasible reframing
cases.prompt: The current concepts for a neighborhood history project are a podcast, walking tour, and photo archive. Make the possibility space stranger and less obvious, but keep the ideas feasible for six volunteers over one summer.
required_behaviors: keep volunteer and time constraints visible

cases.title: Synthesis from unstructured supplied notes
cases.prompt: Turn these notes into an ideation map, without deciding among them: recurring office hours; peer pairing; anonymous question box; rotating demonstrations; searchable examples; concern that experts dominate; no new paid platform; success means newcomers ask for less private rescue after six weeks.
required_behaviors: combine only when the combination changes the mechanism

cases.title: Bounded selection with a current factual premise
cases.prompt: We have already narrowed the launch to option A or option B. Which should we choose, and is the current OpenAI API price still low enough for option B?
required_behaviors: separate the bounded choice from the current factual lookup
route the price question to authoritative research
forbidden_behaviors: recommend A or B without evidence

cases.title: Mixed ideation, preservation, selection, and sending request
cases.prompt: Brainstorm ways to explain the change, save the best one, and send it to Alice. You do not have any other context about Alice, the relationship, the occasion, the channel, or the response I want.
required_behaviors: separate reversible ideation from missing relational judgment
route selection and lifecycle judgment to Elicitation
